_note: 1.3.1 (owner playtest): player settings for the 1.3.0 systems (Student file > Settings), stored in $ui.tune {id: value}. Single source for the engine (tools/gen_engine.py) and the UI (tools/gen_ui.py). def is the value used when nothing is set: gen_engine.py asserts it equals the number in data/training.json / reputation.json, so the default game is unchanged. A value must be one of opts; 0 means 'no limit' or 'off' where the label says so.

groups.name: Proficiency
groups.hint: Weekly practice XP in each field. Class and exam XP are outside this limit.

rows.name: Proficiency pace
rows.hint: Practice XP per stat each week.

groups.name: Training
groups.hint: How fast training grows your mana pool and stamina, in percent of the value you started with.

rows.name: Gain per session
rows.desc: What one real session (an hour or more of drilling) adds, before partner bonuses.

rows.name: Weekly limit
rows.desc: Most that training can add in one week. Gift and Rank 10 jumps ignore it.

rows.name: Lifetime limit
rows.desc: Most that training can ever add to a track.

rows.name: Pace
rows.desc: Multiplies every reputation gain and loss (deeds, bond milestones, tension).

rows.name: Weekly limit for everyday deeds
rows.desc: Repeatable good deeds count up to this much a week per reputation; events and losses have no limit.

rows.name: Bond milestones
rows.desc: A bond reaching Rank 5 or Rank 10 raises the matching reputation (+5 / +10: staff Academy, students Student, Milena Doves).

rows.name: Tension penalty
rows.desc: A bond reaching high Tension (70) costs the matching reputation -5, maximum Tension (100) another -10.

groups.name: Mood and rest
groups.hint: Mood and sleep effects apply with Weather effects set to Full.

rows.name: Mood XP
rows.desc: Good adds and Bad subtracts this much talk/hangout XP.

rows.name: Bad mood tension
rows.desc: Multiplier for tension caused by the player.

rows.name: Good mood apology
rows.desc: Multiplier for accepted apologies.

rows.name: Tired training
rows.desc: Fraction of normal training gains.

rows.name: Sleep debt per hour
rows.desc: Stamina cap lost per late hour.

rows.name: Maximum sleep penalty
rows.desc: Largest stamina cap reduction.

rows.name: Full sleep
rows.desc: Hours needed to clear debt.

rows.name: Gale exposure
rows.desc: Stamina lost per hour outdoors.

groups.name: Body and magic
groups.hint: How your body and magic recover (1.9.9).

rows.name: Mana recovery
rows.desc: Time for an empty mana pool to refill by itself, awake or asleep (1.9.4).

groups.name: Campus life
groups.hint: How often the campus moves by itself (1.9.9).

rows.name: NPC initiative
rows.desc: How often friends (Rank 3+) seek you out on their own (Features: NPC initiative).
opts: Often (at most four times a week)

rows.name: Rumour lifetime
rows.desc: How long a rumour keeps circulating before it dies out (Features: Gossip).

rows.name: Tension fades
rows.desc: How fast tension with someone eases on quiet days without new friction.

rows.name: Absence counts after
rows.desc: Minutes away from your class's room in one period before it counts as skipped (Features: Attendance).

rows.name: Weekly recap
rows.desc: When the Journal gets a one-line recap of the week (Features: Weekly recap).

rows.name: People in a scene on ordinary days
rows.desc: Most people with you at once on a day with nothing on the calendar; one more takes their leave (Features: Small scenes).

rows.name: Ambient moments
rows.desc: How often small things happen around you (Features: Ambience, Full).

groups.name: Studies and dorm rank
groups.hint: How study time prepares you for exams, and how the Results days move your dorm rank (Features: Study and exams).

rows.name: Hours for each level of preparation
rows.desc: Study hours between two exam weeks for shaky / fair / solid / excellent preparation.

rows.name: Dorm rank change per Results day
rows.desc: How far one Results day can move your dorm rank (bands: #1, top 3, top 10, top 25, top 50, the rest).

groups.name: Fortune roll
groups.hint: How often an important, uncertain attempt by you fails or only partly succeeds (1.9.8). Routine actions never roll.

rows.name: Difficulty
rows.desc: Bands of the d100 the engine rolls for each reply, before situational modifiers.
